steps.claim: Euskadi Física fell 1.48 points; the new competency model is to blame.
steps.fate: overturned at step 2: six of nine communities rose in 2026 under the same model

steps.claim: The 2026 fall is regional, not national. H1 survives only as a description of 2025.
steps.fate: its premise — that 2025 was a national collapse — is overturned at step 6

steps.claim: Canarias 2026 sits on the historical locus: the whole distribution moved down.
Only 2 of 187 region-years sit below mean 4.5; the locus there is extrapolated.
steps.fate: the claim of step 3 becomes 'consistent with', not 'demonstrated'

steps.claim: The pass rate is normal; the 8–10 share is not, so its SD units are not calibrated.
2020–24 was a plateau, not a decline; 2025 returned to the 2015–19 norm.
steps.fate: reverses the sign of the national story and enlarges the Basque one

steps.claim: Among passers, the top-band share: the one measure not dominated by the level.
steps.fate: strengthens step 3, shows the plateau reshaped rather than lifted, and finds a Basque turn in 2024 — before either candidate cause

steps.step: 8. Testing the slow version of H4
steps.claim: Do cohorts arrive less prepared each year? Not detectably — take-up is flat.
steps.fate: kills the recruitment mechanism, and corrects a dilution effect this study had itself reported from a phase-undercount of 2015–16

steps.claim: PISA 2006–2022: Basque science goes from +9 above Spain to −5, breaking in 2015.
steps.fate: the drift is real and pre-pandemic, but the cohorts do not match the PAU (1 of 3), which retracts the triangulation step 9 first claimed
